label: Living: timeless versus present at some time of a duration frame
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (living conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' use LIVING_1, the timeless primitive Primitives.Lives. LIVING_2 (LivesSomeTime: life present at some time of a duration frame) is the conclusion shape of the existing route SelfOperationLife and of STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES. Both readings take life as operating from oneself (q.18 a.3); they differ in the time index, and they are not identified. One statement relates them: the open sense bridge 'Whatever is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and is LIVING_2 is LIVING_1' (ad49ea00-287e-4c7c-8ab6-fe222d16d493), restricted to pure act. Its motivation is the open premise STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY (no beginning or end of life without potency in the subject; q.10 a.1 supports only the weaker form, and q.9 a.1 does not cover beginning or ceasing to live), which covers only the step from some time to every time of the frame; the step from every time to timeless LIVING_1 (sempiternal versus eternal) rests on the bridge alone. LivesSomeTime is a reducible definition, so LIVING_2 differs from a raw existential over LivesAt only nominally, and STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES does not yet link this disambiguation (deferred to #216); the unrestricted bridge (whatever lives at some time lives) is not asserted. Only an argument that lists that bridge in sense_bridges passes from LIVING_2 to LIVING_1 (the second routes to the restated sufficiency, nineGiveDeiFiliusLivingFromPureAct, and to the Dei Filius root, deiFiliusRootLivingFromPureAct); the controls show that without the bridge a pure act can be LIVING_2 and not LIVING_1.
